answer: Each identity binds to one state-licensed private investigator licence: background check, exam, surety bond, then the regulator seals it to exactly one identity. It stays lit like an ember only while case logs are filed quarterly. One fake costs 1,600 units and 180 days of vetting, with one lotus-garden surveillance file as field proof; 100 fakes cost 160,000 units and 18,000 days. The cheapest cheat is hiring an investigator for 900 units, but the lender surrenders the licence behind its own identity; a forged licence fails lookup, and any ripple of shared case files exposes both.
